title: Git Namespaces — List Linked Forge Accounts — payload
description: A community administrator lists every member's linked forge accounts, community-wide. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

member.description: Only this member's linked accounts. Absent: every member.

forge.description: Only accounts linked on this forge. Absent: every forge.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`. A consumer supplying a `cursor` MUST NOT also change `member` or `forge` from the request that produced it — start a fresh query instead.

limit.description: Maximum accounts to return in this page. A VTC clamps to 1..=500 (default 100).

AccountRow.title: AccountRow
AccountRow.description: One member's account on one forge, as linked through git-ns/account/link.

member.description: The member the account is linked to.

account.description: The linked account. `id` is authoritative; `login` is as the forge last reported it — display only.

linkedAt.description: When the VTC recorded the link. Absent for a link recorded before this member was tracked.

memberCurrent.description: Whether `member` is still a current member. One whose access lapsed keeps the link — nobody else may link the account — but it projects no forge role, and a forge role it holds cannot be adopted as a right.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — List Linked Forge Accounts — response payload
Response.description: The matching links, ordered by member then forge.

accounts.description: Links matching `member` and `forge`, ordered by `member` then `account.forge`. At most one per member per forge.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page, or `null` when this is the last.
